name: finding-unknowns-skills
tagline_zh: 打工人的外挂：finding-unknowns-skills。英文简介见下。
desc_en: 11 installable skills for Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, and Hermes, for finding your unknowns before they get expensive: blindspot pass, brainstorms, interviews, references, plans, notes, pitches, a merge quiz, plus a context audit, agent interface design, and progressive disclosure. Community distillation, not official Anthropic.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。
